snippet.title: DO NOT Stream GTA 6 on YouTube Until You See This!
snippet.description:
GTA 6 streamers are already getting their livestreams REMOVED by YouTube, with creators reporting Community Guidelines warnings, rejected appeals, and possible strikes over normal Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay.

And here's the ridiculous part: YouTube is promoting its OWN official 24-hour GTA 6 livestream while independent creators are getting punished for streaming the same game!

Multiple creators, including Syndicate, Lucy, Basharkk, Simplistu, gazadventures, and MrJayPlays, have publicly reported GTA 6 livestream removals and moderation problems.

Some say their appeals were rejected. One creator even claims YouTube flagged footage of a BOAT sailing in the ocean under its sexual content policy.

Meanwhile, TeamYouTube warns that certain GTA VI gameplay may violate its nudity and sexual content rules.

So what exactly are creators supposed to do?

In this video, I'm breaking down the screenshots, YouTube's response, the reported removals, and the growing concerns about inconsistent enforcement.

YouTube needs to explain why independent creators are risking their channels while the platform promotes its own GTA 6 livestream celebration.
